    $invocations = [];

    50|        $invocations[] = (string) $process->command;

            "docker info --format '{{.Swarm.LocalNodeState}}'" => Process::result(output: "active\n"),
    60|            "docker info --format '{{.Swarm.NodeID}}'" => Process::result(output: "swarm-node-id\n"),

    50|        $gatewayLeaf = $this->caService->issueLeaf('gateway', [$wireguardAddress]);

   190|        $operationsWebSocketApps = "{$configRoot}/operations-websocket/apps.php";

   200|            'APP_ENV' => 'production',

            'DB_JOURNAL_MODE' => 'wal',

            throw new RuntimeException('Gateway Swarm config root is not configured.');
        }

        return rtrim($configRoot, '/');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services\Operations;

use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Config;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use RuntimeException;

class OperationStreamFrameBroadcaster
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $frame
     */
    public function broadcast(string $channel, array $frame): void
    {
        $appId = Config::string('orbit.operations.reverb.app_id');
        $appKey = Config::string('orbit.operations.reverb.app_key');
        $appSecret = Config::string('orbit.operations.reverb.app_secret');
        $host = Config::string('orbit.operations.reverb.host');
        $port = Config::integer('orbit.operations.reverb.port');
        $scheme = Config::string('orbit.operations.reverb.scheme');
        $timeoutSeconds = Config::integer('orbit.operations.reverb.timeout_seconds', 2);

        $body = [
            'name' => 'operation.stream.frame',
            'channel' => $channel,
            'data' => json_encode($frame, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
        ];

        $encodedBody = json_encode($body, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $path = "/apps/{$appId}/events";
        $query = [
            'auth_key' => $appKey,
            'auth_timestamp' => (string) Carbon::now()->timestamp,
            'auth_version' => '1.0',
            'body_md5' => md5($encodedBody),
        ];

        ksort($query);

        $signaturePayload = "POST\n{$path}\n".http_build_query($query, '', '&', PHP_QUERY_RFC3986);
        $query['auth_signature'] = hash_hmac('sha256', $signaturePayload, $appSecret);

        $url = "{$scheme}://{$host}:{$port}{$path}?".http_build_query($query, '', '&', PHP_QUERY_RFC3986);

        $response = Http::timeout($timeoutSeconds)
            ->withHeaders(['Content-Type' => 'application/json'])
            ->withBody($encodedBody, 'application/json')
            ->post($url);

        if ($response->failed()) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Failed to publish operation stream frame to the operations Reverb service.');
        }
    }
}
